name: Structured sessions
description: Background native Claude and Codex sessions without terminals: journaled messages and permission prompts as asks.

method.description: Starts a structured (no PTY) Claude or Codex conversation, optionally with model and effort picks. `deferStart` reserves a live session and lease without an initial turn; otherwise `prompt` is required. Extra arguments are refused.

worktree.description: A worktree selector; defaults to the caller's worktree.

background.description: When true, prevents automatic terminal tab adoption; explicit viewing remains possible.

deferStart.description: Reserve the live structured session and lease without sending an initial turn.

model.description: A model ID from the agent's catalog, 1 to 128 characters.

lifetime.description: Plugin callers only: stop this live connection when its authenticated creating plugin is disabled or removed. Omit for an independent session.

lifetimeKey.description: With plugin lifetime, groups this connection under the creating plugin's opaque resource key (1 to 128 characters, validated at runtime).

options.description: Launch option picks by option ID, such as { "effort": "high" }: up to 16 entries, each a string or a boolean.

extraArgs.description: Refused: a structured session has no command line.

exitCode.description: The exit code, or null while the process is alive.

exitSignal.description: The signal that ended the process, or null.

exitCause.description: Why the session ended (exited, killed, stopped, host-restart or host-lost), or null while it is alive.

restorable.description: True when the PTY host retains recoverable history after a host loss or reversible stop.

background.description: True when automatic terminal tab adoption is disabled; explicit viewing remains possible.

method.description: The messages of a structured session, optionally only those after `afterSeq`.
Resumes the persisted native Claude or Codex conversation into a new structured session; the optional prompt starts its first turn.

prompt.description: Optional first prompt; omit to connect idle and send later.

lifetime.description: Plugin callers only: bind this resumed live connection to the authenticated creating plugin's lifetime.

lifetimeKey.description: With plugin lifetime, the creating plugin's opaque resource key (1 to 128 characters, validated at runtime).

exitCode.description: The exit code, or null while the process is alive.

background.description: True when automatic terminal tab adoption is disabled; explicit viewing remains possible.

resumedFrom.description: The Quirky session this record resumes.

method.description: Stops a structured provider connection without removing its session record or journal.

expectedIncarnation.description: Stops only this exact live lease incarnation.

method.description: Plugin callers only: stops live connections created by this exact plugin under a resource key, including a create whose reply was lost. Session history is retained.

key.description: The exact creating plugin's resource key, 1 to 128 characters.

method.description: Sends a message to a structured session.

expectedIncarnation.description: When present, sends only to this live structured lease incarnation.

operationId.description: Optional durable idempotency key for exact retry; reusing it with different input is refused.

event.description: A message was added to a structured session.
A structured session finished a turn or needs input.

lastAssistantMessage.description: The text of the latest assistant message of the session since the plugin started, or null.

at.description: When the session settled, in ms since the epoch.
